conviction_note: Two company-level facts pull opposite ways: the first realized loss ($1.5M discount on the Dallas office payoff, which closed in Q3) can cut reported Q3 distributable EPS to about $0.17-0.18 against the $0.23-0.25 guide, but it is smaller than the $6.3M reserve held on that loan. Against that, $122M of Q3 originations, a $122M Q4 pipeline and lower-margin repayments support the Q4 guide and the year-end dividend-coverage promise. Net is near zero. abs_move_pct is set at 4.0, above the 1.78 median, for a stock at 0.44x book and a 17.8% yield where dividend commentary moves the price. p_up is 47 because 5 of the last 7 reactions were negative and beats were sold (the Q1 2026 DE beat drew -1.59%).
bar: Company Q3 2026 distributable EPS guide of $0.23-0.25, given on the Q2 call on 2026-07-29. Two outlets agree on it: https://www.webull.com/news/15313162896483328 (Simply Wall St, 2026-07-29) and the 247wallst Q2 card. No sourced sell-side DE consensus: Benzinga shows the Q3 EPS consensus blank and revenue at $8.9M (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/SEVN/earnings-forecasts). The bar is the company guide; whether that guide includes realized losses is unknown.
positioning_check: Short interest is about 563.5K shares (FINRA 2026-06-30, 2.55 days to cover, 0.5% borrow fee), roughly 2.5% of about 22.4M shares (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/sevn/). Not crowded. No October figure was found. The option chain is unusable (46 contracts of open interest, put/call OI 0.24) and there is no skew. The stock is down 12.88% over 20 days and 38% from its 52-week high, at $6.29 against Q2 GAAP book of $14.15 (0.44x), a 17.8% yield on the $0.28 quarterly. On 2026-10-19 (ex-dividend) it fell from 6.79 to 6.07, about 6.5 points beyond the $0.28 dividend, with no news found.

findings.finding: The Dallas office loan (rated 4, $44.2M) was repaid at about 97% of balance, a $1.5M discount, and closed before 2026-09-30, because office exposure is quoted at 13% 'as of September 30'. SEVN's DE definition says DE is 'reduced for realized losses ... generally at the time a loan is repaid'. This is the company's first realized loss: about $0.067 per share on 22.4M shares. Reported Q3 DE could therefore print about $0.17-0.18 against the $0.23-0.25 guide if the guide excluded the loss. GAAP EPS should be lifted by releasing most of the $6.3M CECL reserve held on this loan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior realized loss to compare. On DE: the Q2 2026 DE of $0.23, at the low end of guide with a $4.9M provision, drew -4.73%. The Q1 2026 DE beat ($0.24 vs about $0.238) drew -1.59%.
findings.why_not_priced: The discount was disclosed on Oct 5 as a positive (loss far below reserve), and the stock rose 1.3% that day. No source found translates it into a DE-per-share hit. If it were priced, the Q3 DE expectation would sit around $0.18 rather than the $0.23-0.25 guide, and nothing found shows that. The reserve release makes the GAAP headline a likely beat, so the headline numbers will disagree with each other.
findings.independence: The DE definition and the 22,419K weighted shares come from a different document, the Q2 2026 earnings presentation (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001452477/000145247726000028/sevnq22026earningspresen.htm, slides 20-21). The size of the loss rests only on the Oct 5 update.

findings.finding: Since the start of Q3, SEVN closed $122.3M of first-mortgage loans and has three loans ($121.7M) in diligence to close in Q4. It is recycling lower-yield loans: Dallas office was about 80bp and Fayetteville self-storage ($25.3M, repaid in full) about 100bp below the year-to-date new-loan NIM. Carlsbad office ($24.5M, rated 4) is expected to repay in Q4. Together these support a Q4 DE guide toward the $0.28 dividend ('coverage by year end'), against $0.23 in Q2 and a portfolio of about $790M versus a $950M target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 call reaffirmed coverage by year end and guided Q3 to $0.23-0.25. The stock still fell 4.73%: a guide below the dividend was sold. No instance found of a guide at or above the dividend.
findings.why_not_priced: At a 17.8% yield and 0.44x book, the stock is priced for a dividend cut, not for coverage. A Q4 guide at or near $0.28 would contradict that price. If the market believed coverage, the yield would sit near the 12-14% the stock carried at $7.66-8.00 in July-August.
findings.independence: Same document as finding 1, a different line. The $950M target and the 1.86% 2026-origination NIM come from the Q2 call summary (https://www.webull.com/news/15313162896483328).

findings.finding: The Passaic, NJ industrial loan ($45.3M principal, rated 4, 69% LTV, the largest risk-4 loan) matured on 2026-09-08 with extension options to 2027-09-08. The Oct 5 business update listed Q3 repayments and did not mention it, so it was most likely extended or modified rather than repaid. A Q3 risk-rating change, a modification or added reserve on it would come out in the release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 2026 provision jump ($4.9M, driven by two office loans near maturity) came with a -4.73% reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: The status of this loan is not in any public document after the maturity date. This is an inference from omission (it is not in the Oct 5 list), so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The omission is read from the Oct 5 update (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1452477/000110465926113721/tm2627052d1_ex99-1.htm). The maturity terms come from the Q2 deck. Proxy only.

findings.finding: Positioning: the stock is at $6.29, -12.88% over 20 days, 0.44x Q2 GAAP book ($14.15) and 0.43x adjusted book ($14.79), a 17.8% yield. That includes an unexplained ~6.5-point drop beyond the dividend on ex-date 2026-10-19 (6.79 to 6.07). Short interest is about 2.5% of shares (2.55 days to cover). Any reassurance on dividend or credit lands on a price that already discounts a cut.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 5 of the last 7 reactions were negative and the median absolute move is 1.78%. No print found on a comparable discount to book.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself, so it is priced by definition. It is filed as context, sized 0 (LESSONS rule 5: an unexplained drawdown in a microcap is worth 0).
findings.independence: Short interest from https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/sevn/ (FINRA 2026-06-30). Book value from the Q2 deck.

findings.finding: Sector proxy: commercial mortgage REIT peers cut dividends through mid-2026 against the year before: KREF $0.25 to $0.10, FBRT $0.355 to $0.20, ABR $0.30 to $0.17. BXMT, STWD, TRTX, LADR and ACRE held. SEVN's own payout ratio was 122% in Q2.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the 17.8% yield already says the market expects a cut. This is a sector proxy, not a SEVN number, so it is sized small. The Q4 dividend decision itself comes in mid-January, outside the window; only the call commentary is inside it.
findings.independence: Proxy only. SEVN's 122% Q2 payout is from https://www.webull.com/news/15313162896483328.

Carlsbad, CA office loan ($24.5M, rated 4, matures 2026-10-27) is expected to repay in Q4. Any discount would be realized in Q4 DE, reported in February.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The 20-day drawdown and 0.44x book already price a dividend cut. The negative finding (realized loss hits DE) points with the drawdown; the guidance finding cuts against it. The net is near zero, and p_up 47 reflects this name's habit of negative reactions rather than conviction.
lessons_applied: Rule 2 (one-offs as one-offs): the realized Dallas loss is a credit item smaller than the reserve held against it, so it was shrunk from -1.0 to -0.6.
Rule 1 (reaction function): beats and reaffirmed coverage have been sold here (Q1 DE beat -1.59%), so the guidance finding was shrunk from +1.0 to +0.7.
Rule 5 (inference from absence is weak): the Passaic finding rests on an omission, so it was shrunk from -0.5 to -0.3.
Rule 5 (an unexplained microcap drawdown is worth 0): the positioning finding was shrunk from +0.5 to 0.0.
abs_move_pct and p_up were left unchanged.
